long_winter: A colossal blizzard shaped like a frost giant rising over a tiny walled village half-buried in snow, frozen river, pale small sun behind the storm, one warm hearth light glowing in a single window resisting the cold.
steppe_horde: A towering wall of dust on the steppe with the shadows of hundreds of horse archers galloping out of it under red war banners, war drums, a lone watchtower of a small village in the foreground about to be engulfed.
great_flood: A gigantic wave of brown floodwater bursting over a river valley, drowning fields and mud-brick houses, rooftops and a lone reed boat with tiny figures clinging to it, endless rain slashing from a dark sky, lightning over distant hilltops.
dark_prophecy: A blindfolded oracle on a tripod above a smoking chasm, violet smoke rising and forming a colossal skull-like face with a single burning eye in the sky above a distant city, ashes drifting like snow.
schism: Two rival high priests facing each other across a cracked stone altar, one holding a white flame and one a crimson flame, the temple split down the middle by a jagged glowing fissure, crowds divided in shadow on either side.
sea_peoples: A fleet of black-sailed raider longships with monstrous prows emerging from a storm-tossed sea fog at night, torches blazing, a small coastal town with a lighthouse on the shore beneath them, waves crashing.
rival_ascendant: A colossal crowned warlord silhouette in crimson armour rising over the horizon like a second sun, casting a huge shadow over a small city, a burning torn treaty drifting in the wind, legions marching below.
plague: A hooded plague doctor with a long beaked mask walking a deserted medieval street at night carrying a lantern, sickly green miasma curling through the alleys, a lone bell tower with a silent bell, rats at the gutters, doors marked with shadows.
iconoclasm: A mob with raised hammers toppling a great gilded saint statue from a cathedral pedestal, its golden mask shattering into flying fragments, torchlight and dust, stained glass cracking above.
famine: Cracked barren earth and withered black wheat stalks under a merciless bronze sun, an empty granary with open doors, a thin mother holding a child on the dusty road, crows circling.
peasant_revolt: An angry crowd of peasants with pitchforks, torches and scythes storming the gates of a noble manor at night, flames leaping from the roof, a toppled carriage, silhouettes against a fiery orange sky.
comet_omen: A gigantic blood-red comet with a burning tail tearing across a violet night sky over a Renaissance city, astrologers on a rooftop observatory recoiling, the whole city bathed in eerie light.
debt_crisis: A king's golden treasury vault stripped bare, a crowned figure slumped on an empty throne, stacks of coins crumbling into dust and slipping away through cracks in the floor, a single guttering candle.
trade_collapse: Abandoned merchant galleons rotting at anchor in a silent grey harbour, sails in tatters, unsold silk bales and spice crates piled on an empty rain-soaked quay, gulls on broken masts.
industrial_smog: A choking industrial city drowned in thick yellow-black smog, towering smokestacks belching soot, gas lamps burning at noon, silhouettes of coughing workers with rags over their faces on an iron bridge.
pandemic: A vast translucent green serpent of miasma coiling around the skyscrapers of a modern city at dusk, empty streets, ambulance lights glowing, a lone masked doctor looking up at it.
world_war: A burning sky full of biplanes and zeppelins above a no-man's-land of trenches, barbed wire and tanks, searchlights crossing, a torn battle flag on a splintered pole in the foreground, fire on every horizon.
nuclear_standoff: Two colossal shadowy hands reaching toward two glowing red buttons above a sleeping modern city at night, a faint ghostly mushroom-cloud silhouette reflected in the sky, the world holding its breath.
great_blackout: A vast modern city skyline plunged into total darkness at dusk, skyscrapers black, one enormous lightning bolt splitting the sky and briefly lighting the dead towers, a single candle flickering in one window in the foreground.
